name: Cloady
tagline: Deploy apps and databases, inspect logs, and manage cloud resources.
description: Connect Cline to Cloady to inspect workspaces, applications, deployments, logs, metrics, and database templates, and manage hosting resources through the hosted MCP server. Sign in with a Cloady account through OAuth and choose the narrowest scope needed for your task. Review the target workspace and any charges before approving resource changes.

install.notes: Authenticate with Cloady through OAuth. Access depends on the selected scope and workspace role; an account-level connection may cover multiple workspaces. The connector is free, while hosted resources follow Cloady's pricing. Tool results are shared with your AI client. Privacy: https://cloady.com/privacy. Support: hello@cloady.com.
